simple.meaning: חָרָשׁ (chârâsh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a fabricator or any material.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 28:11. The surrounding context includes family line, kingship, land, Israel.
